parsed.name: rLINE电动移液器
parsed.description: 用于控制 rLINE 电动移液器进行吸液、分液、吹出、退吸头、回零和复位，并读取位置与级别反馈，适合实验室自动化液体处理流程。
parsed.description_en: Controls an rLINE electronic pipette for aspiration, dispensing, blowout, tip ejection, homing, and reset, while reading position and level feedback for automated laboratory liquid-handling workflows.
